description: This file defines a function to extract audio mode tags from text, supporting inline directives such as [[audio_as_voice]]. It leverages an imported utility function to parse inline directives and returns an object indicating the presence of audio tags and whether audio should be sent as a voice message.

methods.name: export function parseAudioTag(text?: string): { parseAudioTag
methods.description: Extracts audio mode tags from input text, returning an object with the text, a flag indicating if audio is to be sent as voice, and a flag indicating whether a tag was present.
